northStar: A ward handover board: enamel field under a steel rail, one magnetic tile per case, acuity colour doing the triage before a word is read. Read it from across the room.

motion.rule: State only, never decoration. One authored moment: a control goes down when pressed (active:translate-y-px, shadow removed). Charts do not animate on mount — a count that arrives by animation is a count you wait for.

focus.rule: :focus:not(:focus-visible) { outline: none } — Recharts makes its plot focusable for arrow-key traversal, and clicking it would otherwise earn the UA's blue ring.

typeAxes.sans: Archivo variable, wght 100-900 + wdth 62-125; column heads at wdth 84%
typeAxes.note: axes: ['wdth'] must stay in layout.tsx or every column head silently renders at normal width

charts.library: recharts 3.10.1 for the two time-series plates
charts.handDrawn: distribution rings — Recharts 3 removed activeIndex from Pie
charts.palette: read from the document via useBoardPalette; var() does not resolve in SVG presentation attributes

notCanonized: The disabled solid button sits at 45% opacity and its label falls below 4.5:1. That is the standard disabled affordance and is deliberate, but it is not a contrast rule future surfaces should copy.
The resolution-note placeholder is set at ink-faint (5.36:1). It clears the contrast floor but reads close to a real value; the accessible choice was kept over the softer one.
